API Hub Onboarding

This section covers the end-to-end process for onboarding your institution to the API Hub. Onboarding is managed through the Nebras Service Desk and involves providing configuration details, exchanging certificates, and provisioning your API Hub instance.

API Hub Onboarding > Prerequisites > Trust Framework registration and a Primary Technical Contact

Before you can begin API Hub onboarding, the following MUST be in place:

- Trust Framework registration — Your organisation MUST be onboarded to the appropriate Trust Framework environment: Pre-production API Hub → Sandbox Trust Framework Production API Hub → Production Trust Framework See Trust Framework Onboarding for details.
- Pre-production API Hub → Sandbox Trust Framework
- Production API Hub → Production Trust Framework
- Primary Technical Contact (PTC) — A Primary Technical Contact MUST have been registered for your organisation so that applications, servers, and certificates can be created in the Trust Framework. The PTC is responsible for managing the technical connectivity between your institution and the API Hub.

metadata.title: API Hub Onboarding
metadata.section: Trust Framework registration and a Primary Technical Contact

chunks.text:
API Hub Onboarding > Requesting onboarding > Email Nebras Support to raise the tickets

To begin onboarding, send the following email to support@nebrasopenfinance.ae:

To: support@nebrasopenfinance.ae

Subject: API Hub Onboarding Request — [Your Organisation Name] — [Environment]

Dear Nebras Support,

I wish to begin API Hub onboarding for the following:

- Organisation: [Your Organisation Name]
- Environment: [Pre-production / Production]
- Primary Technical Contact (PTC): [Name and email of the PTC who will manage the technical connectivity]

Please raise the onboarding tickets and provide the next steps.

Once received, the Nebras support team will raise JIRA tickets to track each stage of the onboarding process.

metadata.title: API Hub Onboarding
metadata.section: Email Nebras Support to raise the tickets

chunks.text:
API Hub Onboarding > Onboarding steps > Three stages tracked via Service Desk tickets

API Hub onboarding proceeds through three stages. Each stage is tracked via a separate Service Desk ticket.

metadata.title: API Hub Onboarding
metadata.section: Three stages tracked via Service Desk tickets

chunks.text:
API Hub Onboarding > Onboarding steps > Three stages tracked via Service Desk tickets > 1. Prerequisites Questionnaire

You will be asked to provide organisational details, infrastructure information, and your preferred configuration options. This information is used to provision your API Hub instance.

See Prerequisites for the full list of fields.

metadata.title: API Hub Onboarding
metadata.section: Three stages tracked via Service Desk tickets

chunks.text:
API Hub Onboarding > Onboarding steps > Three stages tracked via Service Desk tickets > 2. Application Layer Authentication

You MUST select an application layer authentication method to secure communication between the API Hub and your Ozone Connect endpoints. The available methods are:

- mTLS Only
- API Key
- Client Credentials Grant
- JWT Auth (recommended)

See Application Layer Authentication for a comparison of methods, and Configuring Authentication for implementation guidance on the mTLS and JWT Auth layers.

metadata.title: API Hub Onboarding
metadata.section: Three stages tracked via Service Desk tickets

chunks.text:
API Hub Onboarding > Onboarding steps > Three stages tracked via Service Desk tickets > 3. Environment-Specific Configuration

You will exchange certificates, URLs, and domain-specific values with Ozone. This process MUST be completed separately for each environment (pre-production and production).

See Environment-Specific Configuration for the full list of fields and certificate details.

metadata.title: API Hub Onboarding
metadata.section: Three stages tracked via Service Desk tickets

chunks.text:
API Hub Onboarding > After onboarding > Publish your server and implement your endpoints

Once your API Hub is provisioned and configured, you will need to:

- Publish your API Hub as a server in the Trust Framework so that TPPs can discover your institution. See Creating a Server.
- Implement your Ozone Connect endpoints
